rationale: LOGISTEC's January 8, 2024 take-private closed through a Blue Wolf-controlled purchaser with Stonepeak providing preferred equity, so the current record is wrong to show Stonepeak as the sole owner. The June 15, 2026 Enstructure agreement covers the Marine Terminal Division, but U.S. and Canadian clearances did not establish a legal closing by the cutoff. LOGISTEC Marine and its current owners must therefore remain active with a signed pending exit, while CoreAqua and SANEXEN are separated as retained environmental platforms.
recommendedChanges: Keep one canonical LOGISTEC Marine platform through August 19, 2026 and use LOGISTEC Marine Services ULC and LOGISTEC Marine TopCo ULC as legal-boundary evidence.
Add Blue Wolf Capital Partners as the active majority/common-control owner from January 8, 2024.
Correct Stonepeak from sole owner to an active preferred-equity investor from January 8, 2024; leave the exact fund, amount and percentage publicly undisclosed.
Record former public shareholders as exited on the January 8, 2024 take-private close.
Record Enstructure's purchase of all marine terminal operations as SIGNED_PENDING_EXIT from June 15, 2026 with no closing date as of the cutoff.
Remove CoreAqua and SANEXEN from LOGISTEC Marine's current perimeter and route them to separate qualification reviews; do not infer Stonepeak ownership of either retained platform.
Do not add Investissement Québec or change current owners based on regulatory clearances alone.
unresolvedQuestions: Stonepeak's fund, preferred amount, later obligor and post-close rollover or exit treatment are not publicly disclosed.
Minority and management stakes and their treatment in the pending sale are not publicly disclosed.
CoreAqua and SANEXEN require separate qualification and ownership review.
